prompt.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer sits at the screen-side window seat and asks a question, a man in an olive sweater sits at the door-side window seat, and a woman in a mustard blouse sits at the screen-end seat.
prompt.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.beat: Subject B leaves that seat and exits. Subject A asks a question.

prompt.content: The man in an olive sweater leaves the door-side window seat and exits the venue, while the woman in a navy blazer asks a question.
prompt.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

prompt.content: The woman in a navy blazer answers.
prompt.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
